test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What is the difference between the compound interests on Rs. 8,000 for 1 year at 6% per annum compounded yearly and half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 8,000

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) when compounded yearly:

CI = P (1 + R/100)T - P

Compound Interest when compounded half-yearly:

CI = P (1 + (R/2)/100)²T - P

**Calculation:**

For yearly compounding:

CIyₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1 + 6/100)¹ - 8000

⇒ CIyₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1 + 0.06) - 8000

⇒ CIyₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 × 1.06 - 8000

⇒ CIyₑₐᵣₗy = 8480 - 8000

⇒ CIyₑₐᵣₗy = 480

For half-yearly compounding:

CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1 + (6/2)/100)²×¹ - 8000

⇒ CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1 + 3/100)² - 8000

⇒ CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1 + 0.03)² - 8000

⇒ CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 8000 (1.03)² - 8000

⇒ CIhalf-yearly = 8000(1.0609) - 8000

⇒ CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 8487.2 - 8000

⇒ CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy = 487.2

Difference = CIₕₐₗf₋yₑₐᵣₗy - CIyₑₐᵣₗy

⇒ Difference = 487.2 - 480

⇒ Difference = 7.2

**The difference between the compound interests is Rs. 7.2.**

**The correct answer is option 1.**
